body:
Adds `research/odometry-twin` (ARPG-related, stylised 1-D): a twin fitted to one-step odometry noise cannot see persistent drift. Exact variance ratio `1+(T-1)ρ`, relocalisation interval 3.4× too long at ρ=0.05, twin-tuned loop-closure gate recall, closed-loop runaway, aliasing limit of calibrated gates, and a lag-fitted variance repair. 10 tests; results in `experiments/results.txt`.

Also updates the README bullet and `site/projects.json`; `python site/build.py` prints ok (123 projects, 1138 tests).
